'''Scorchwing''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Critters|Tatari]]. It evolves form [[Sparkrow]] at 5 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Scorchwing's temper has gotten just as combustible as the feathers. If the attacks suddenly stop, that is not signal for a break. That is a bigger fireball being loaded."

Scorchwing is an early game, purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A chubby red bird with yellow and orangish accents. Its underbelly is white, and it has dark brown eye tufts and lighter brown cheeks. Its tail has a firey gradient, and its angry expression consists of two light yellow eyes and a dark almost black beak. 

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Scorchwing grew big wings, but its body grew even larger. Now it has a tough time flying off."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Scorchwing may have grown bigger in size, but so did their temper. Territory intruders will have a wing-furling, shrieking fireball of fury on their hands."

==Strategy==
[[File:Scorchwing Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Scorchwing's attack range]]
Good mid game DPS. Use until better fire DPS is acquired, or in case of a grass heavy [[Zobos|Zobo]] assault.
